units: 6 arbitrary horizontal units = 3 game cells; not meters
sectorOrder: 0 front, increments toward building right around circumference
fixed: all geometry; no mechanical motion rig
work: two adjacent panels at a time, sequence moves around band
idle: diagnostic sequence inactive; background lamps may stay steady
cancelled: end active sequence and return to idle
complete: end sequence; optional brief uniform confirmation with no gameplay delay
timing: not approved; gallery timing is schematic only
limits: Eight-sector shared scaffold, not exact shell reconstruction. Facet/panel count in artistic sheets must be checked against single geometry.
